property_summary: For every call to transfer(...) the reference contract reverts if the `_tos` array is empty (i.e., transfer requires _tos.length > 0); the mutant that uses require(_tos.length >= 0) can accept empty `_tos` and thus will not revert for empty arrays, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Change the require that checks _tos.length>0 to require(_tos.length >= 0) which will always hold and thus remove the original precondition that could revert when array is empty.
